name: The Affair
source:
The Affair is a short kinetic novel created for The Teacup Visual Novel Festival 2011. The challenge was to write a story with generic backgrounds and at least two female characters. Inspired by mid-nineties to 2000s romantic comedy anime such as Ranma 1/2, Love Hina and Onegai Twins. 

[Edited from [url=http://rd2k2-games.blogspot.com/2011/07/affair-teacup-vn-festival-2011.html]Radical Dreamers 2002[/url]]
translation:
《事件》是为2011年茶杯视觉小说节创作的一部短篇动态小说。挑战是编写一个具有通用背景和至少两个女性角色的故事。灵感源自90年代中期至2000年代的浪漫喜剧动漫，如《乱马1/2》、《Love Hina》和《Onegai Twins》。

[编辑自[url=http://rd2k2-games.blogspot.com/2011/07/affair-teacup-vn-festival-2011.html]激进梦想家2002[/url]]
